Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a logical error in comparing the dates. It stated: "Normalizing across cross-region year discrepancies by comparing month-day only (11-26 vs 09-15), Under the Hawthorn Tree came out earlier." This is factually incorrect. The year 1965 is significantly earlier than the year 2010. By ignoring the years and only comparing the month and day, the Planner reached the wrong conclusion that the 2010 film was released earlier than the 1965 film. The correct comparison shows that November 26, 1965 is much earlier than September 15, 2010.
